programme.title: The Zoo: The Marvelous Mott Mott
programme.desc: Beloved camel Max develops a large abscess on the top of his head a marmot prepares for her first classroom visit as an ambassador animal a peregrine falcon found at the base of a skyscraper is brought to the zoo for a health check.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell: My Pup From Hell
programme.desc: Jackson works with Sydney, a Bengal, who's welcoming his new stepmom and new pit bull brother into the family by spraying every piece of furniture in the house an energetic cat, Stella, threatens to harm a toddler.

programme.title: Mystery of the Lost Islands: Killer Whale Island
programme.desc: Predator expert Dave Salmoni travels to a remote speck of land in the wild and stormy South Atlantic, which is visited by a huge number of hunting killer whales.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Tiger Eyes
programme.desc: Hunter the Sumatran tiger is blind and must be sedated for his annual eye check the keepers prepare young giraffe Scarlett for a road trip to South Australia, reuniting her with family.

programme.title: Meet the Orangutans: Settling In
programme.desc: One orphan is new on the scene and needs another, more experienced one to help them settle in the babies are at high risk from parasites ingested from the ground.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.: Sold Into Slavery
programme.desc: Ivan is investigating the illegal trade of bush meat in Kinshasa when he stumbles upon three captive baby chimpanzees that are being sold on the black market.

programme.title: Return to Shark Vortex
programme.desc: As the Shark Vortex retreats in the fall, sharks battle it out for dominance in New England's icy waters experts Dr. Greg Skomal, Joe and Lauren Romeiro brave rough oceans and fierce predators to capture new footage and insight.

programme.title: The Zoo: Otter Under the Weather
programme.desc: A 14-year-old otter is not its usual, energetic self staff at the New York Aquarium move their sharks to a new exhibit quirky capercaillies need help producing healthy chicks.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell: Pee Battle
programme.desc: Jackson deals with a mother-daughter duo whose lovable cats have pissing matches that are destroying not only their furniture but also their relationship the Cat Daddy connects with Cat From Heaven, Ziggy, who has CPR skills.
